audit.description: The changed production file tinylang/__init__.py replaces `from dotenv import load_dotenv` and `load_dotenv()` with `from environs import Env` and `Env().read_env()`, which is meaningful use of the target library. Static and dynamic evidence show no source-library imports from production repo code, and the observed environs import resolves to site-packages rather than a local fake provider.
evidence: Unified diff: tinylang/__init__.py changes from dotenv.load_dotenv() to environs.Env().read_env()
Static anti-cheat: tinylang/__init__.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_import from tinylang/__init__.py line 1 for module environs with origin under site-packages/environs/__init__.py
reasons: Changed production code imports and calls environs.Env
No changed production code imports dotenv or python_dotenv
No local target shim/provider was detected
The only source import observed came from the environs dependency itself, not repo production code
